# Intrepid Travel

> > Small group adventure travel company offering responsible tours across 100+ countries including Peru, Tanzania, Alaska, Norway, and multi-country expeditions.

Intrepid Travel specializes in sustainable adventure tours with experiences ranging from trekking the Inca Trail to Machu Picchu, witnessing the Northern Lights in Scandinavia, exploring African safaris, and discovering remote destinations. Tours emphasize authentic cultural experiences, wildlife encounters, and outdoor adventures led by local guides.

## Key Topics

- Adventure travel
- Small group tours
- Machu Picchu & Inca Trail
- Wildlife safaris
- Northern Lights expeditions
- Multi-country tours
- Sustainable & responsible travel
- Kayaking & outdoor activities
- Latin America exploration
- Scandinavia travel
- Alaska wilderness tours
- West Africa adventures
- City tours & cultural experiences
- National park visits
- Seasonal tour departures
